sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: 'Quality Checks' row 54 (#53) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 54 (#53; no internal annotation, no cell comments)
projects/threadline-chat/threadline-chat/instruction.md and task.toml (closest sibling in the same messaging domain)
evidence: Kittle is authored for a specific product: instruction.md speaks as Kittle & Rowe, a small law firm (clients emailing documents to whoever answered last), and the notes ground every rule in legal practice - ethical walls ('a leak is a professional-conduct problem for us', walls-and-retention.md 'Who sees a matter'), partner-only legal holds overriding disappearing-message timers, transcripts as 'our record of a matter', patchy court internet motivating idempotent sends (conversations.md 'Sending and live updates'). The only same-domain sibling, projects/threadline-chat (webdev/threadline-chat, 'Slack-style team messaging workspace'), has a different concept and flow set: channels/DMs, reactions, pins, presence/typing, incoming webhooks, moderator roles and tab-scoped sessions; Kittle explicitly excludes reactions/presence/typing and instead centres matter-scoped ethical walls across every side channel (list, search snippets, reply quotes, unread, mentions, message-link previews, transcripts, live wall addition), timer/hold retention semantics with an exact-age boundary and hold release, nested replies with deleted-parent placeholders, and matter transcripts. Overlapping generic chat features (threads, edits, unread, mentions, search, links) are re-specified around matter/wall/retention rules, not copied; the 16 functional criteria (wall_every_route, wall_mentions_and_links, wall_added_live, timer_changes, hold_scope_and_release, search_and_transcript, etc.) have no counterpart in Threadline. It fits the suite plan: task.toml category 'Messaging & Chat Interfaces' and a unique arena_slice 'full-stack-express-sqlite-messaging-chat-kittle-matter-chat', matching handoffs/KITTLE_BUILD_CONTEXT.txt section 0 ('Keep task.toml category = "Messaging & Chat Interfaces"') and its section 5 plan; no other project uses this domain/slice. A grep of the frozen task for sibling product names (colderwater, hireops, threadline, ridgeline, bazaar, drawbill, docketlight, northstar, playground) and the template placeholder CHANGE_ME returned no hits. Adversarial check: a nouns-swapped Threadline (channels->matters) would lack walls, holds, timers and transcripts and would fail most criteria; conversely Kittle is not reducible to renaming any sibling's flows. Limitation: no formal suite domain-plan document exists beyond the category/handoff notes; this row is semantic and needs no runtime evidence.
